pages.title: Hexagonal Field Glass
pages.text: Glass held together by a hexagonal force field, like a honeycomb of light. Each cell glows faintly at its edges. It is strong and very slightly warm to the touch. Tapping it makes each hexagon ring separately, a soft chiming that dies away quickly.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I wanted a stronger glass for labs. A hexagonal field pattern spread stress evenly across every cell, and the honeycomb glow came free.
